questions.question: In computer architecture and instruction set design, what is the defining characteristic of a strictly Load-Store (Register-Register) architecture?
options: All arithmetic and logical instructions operate exclusively on registers, with memory access restricted to dedicated load and store instructions.
Operands for arithmetic operations are popped from and results pushed directly onto a hardware memory stack.
Every arithmetic instruction can encode both memory addresses and register operands interchangeably.
Memory can be accessed without address translation by entirely bypassing the memory management unit.
Instruction word lengths are variable and depend dynamically on the width of the system memory bus.

questions.question: In synchronous digital IC design and static timing analysis (STA), what is the fundamental distinction between clock skew and clock jitter?
options: Skew is caused entirely by thermal noise inside transistors, while jitter is caused by routing resistance.
Skew can only be measured after silicon fabrication, while jitter is modeled deterministically during synthesis.
Skew represents the spatial variation in arrival times between two clock destinations, while jitter represents the temporal variation of clock edges at a single point over time.
Skew impacts only dynamic power dissipation, while jitter impacts only static leakage current.
Skew can cause only hold-time violations, while jitter can cause only setup-time violations.

questions.question: In high-performance processor memory hierarchies, what is the primary latency advantage of a Virtually Indexed, Physically Tagged (VIPT) cache over a Physically Indexed, Physically Tagged (PIPT) cache?
options: It completely eliminates the need to maintain cache tags in the cache array.
It inherently prevents any potential cache aliasing (homonyms and synonyms) across processes.
It eliminates the need to include a hardware Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) on chip.
It allows the cache index lookup to proceed in parallel with virtual-to-physical address translation in the TLB.
It compresses tag array storage by retaining only the upper unmapped virtual address bits.

questions.question: In advanced semiconductor manufacturing nodes (below 22nm), what is the primary physical motivation for transitioning from planar bulk CMOS transistors to multi-gate architectures such as FinFETs and Nanosheet/Gate-All-Around (GAA) FETs?
options: To replace silicon channels with high-mobility III-V semiconductor materials without changing layout topology.
To enhance electrostatic gate control over the channel from multiple sides, suppressing short-channel effects like drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL).
To eliminate the requirement for high-k metal gate dielectric stacks like hafnium oxide.
To enable negative threshold voltage operation to completely eliminate static leakage power.
To reduce the number of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) photolithography masks required during front-end fabrication.

questions.question: In vector processor architectures, what is the operational mechanism and primary performance advantage of vector register chaining?
options: Combining multiple physical vector registers into a single logical register to double memory load throughput.
Broadcasting a single scalar value simultaneously across all SIMD lanes to bypass vector execution pipelines.
Dynamically rescheduling independent vector instructions into scalar instruction windows to avoid hazards.
Prefetching contiguous blocks of vector memory lines directly into L1 caches using hardware stride counters.
Forwarding intermediate elements from the output of one vector functional unit directly to the input of a dependent functional unit before the entire vector completes.
